policy: V26 makes current distribution capacity consume fee-aware DistributionBudgetState v2 explicitly. Historical AvailableCapacity v2 remains immutable; the v3 path rejects BudgetState v1 and exposes gross profit budget, post-close settlement fees, fee-adjusted budget, net distributed amount and remaining entitlement before applying current HardNAV/liquidity headroom.

additions.authority_note: Non-authorizing fee-aware current distribution capacity. Requires distribution.budget-state/v2; final capacity=min(remaining fee-adjusted period budget,current HardNAV solvency headroom,current liquidity headroom) unless blockers. No authorization/payment/execution/AI authority.
